notes.claim: Elimination wants the coefficients of one variable to be opposites, so that adding the equations eliminates that variable.
Sometimes an equation must first be multiplied throughout before one letter can be eliminated.
In one study, 76% of students misjudged which operation to use when eliminating, sometimes adding when they should subtract.
